issues.detail: The Hebrew 'מִכָּל שְׁבָטֶיךָ' means 'from all your tribes' (i.e., the tribes of Israel), but the Chinese renders it as '從你一切杖中' ('from all your staffs/rods'), which is a mistranslation of 'שְׁבָטֶיךָ' (tribes) as '杖' (staff/rod). This changes the meaning from tribal selection to an object.
